recommendation_summary: Set up one external dead-man's-switch monitor that `nightly-sync` pings only after a successful run, so a missed ping triggers an alert. Keep the job on `edna` and skip the Synology and Docker.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to hear when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker infrastructure for this one job.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends email only if it reaches the email step, so a startup crash stays silent.
labels.Checked myself: From your account, cron runs it at 03:00 on `edna`; four startup crashes produced no email, and nothing else monitors it.

note: The reply recommends one heartbeat alert, rejects the Synology/Docker idea, and its Checked myself line uses only facts from the situation, credited to the user's account.
